items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15

ctx.x: I'm going to play something. And they had some people from West Germany, and they recorded the one thing. And I was supposed to get one of the records and all that, and a little magazine from West Germany, which I never get from Joe, you know, from Joe Moran.

I may have that in a book, man. I may have your picture in a book, I might. From Germany. Was Pinky playing too much? Yeah. I think I have a picture of that. And you had a woman singing gospel songs? Right. Yeah. How is it, Betty? Is it a machine worker?
